hardware: RTX 5070 Ti (SM120), Ryzen 9 9950X3D, WSL2, shared desktop
kv: FP16 keys and values on CUDA0
method: Serial, single llama-server process, 1536 token microbatch, greedy code completions using scripts/bench-code-context (256 output tokens unless the row records another length) and cold prompts. Rates are measured per request. Actual cache capacity can differ with available desktop headroom. Device peaks include the desktop and earlier requests within that model worker.

cuda_activity.scope: Original runtime, normal CUDA graphs, actual steady-state process_ubatch on generated steps 22 and 23 of an independent short code prompt. CUPTI kernel and memcpy activity collection was enabled on these two steps only. Profiling did not overlap timed comparisons.
cuda_activity.controller_identification: Shape-specific 4608-to-64 FP32 matvec anchor plus its validated neighboring concat, both 64-to-2304 matvecs, two tanh operations and four gated arithmetic ops. Includes adjacent input copies and RMSNorm when contiguous. Spans and busy time are unions on the GPU timeline. Precomputed inputs and other CPU work are excluded.

mapped_copy_microbenchmark.method: Q4 XL gate/up and down bank strides, GPU copying registered host memory versus batched DMA on the same device; byte-checked, including undisturbed slots. Synthetic throughput does not measure end-to-end decode.

quality_vs_reference.limitations: Intervals use the 48 authored questions as independent observations. Scores apply to single-token forced choices on this fixed suite; they do not establish general model equivalence. Lower gold NLL is better.

equal_budget_capacity.method: Allocator calculation for 7168 MiB of expert bank space with normalized fractions from the GGUF tensor byte strides and one guard slot per pool. Excludes separately charged router metadata.
